component.name: NotePadLX
component.summary: Source code editor, a Linux port of Notepad++

description.p: NotePadLX brings Notepad++ to Linux as a native Qt 6 application, ported from the Notepad++ sources. It keeps the Notepad++ editing engine (Scintilla and Lexilla), its themes and its configuration files.

ul.li: Syntax highlighting and folding for more than 80 languages, plus user defined languages
Notepad++ themes, with Solarized as the default dark theme
Find and Replace, Find in Files, Mark, the Finder, regular expressions
Macro recording and playback, the Run menu
Function list, document map, document list, folder as workspace, project panels
Column editor, MD5 and SHA hashes, multi-selection and column mode

screenshot.caption: Editing C++ with the Solarized theme, the function list and the document map

description.p: Session snapshot and periodic backup are on by default again: unsaved changes survive closing, a crash or a power loss, without asking to save on exit. The tab bar no longer disappears when a file is opened from the file manager.

Plugins: a Linux plugin API that keeps the Notepad++ plugin interface (menu commands, notifications, NPPM messages, docked panels), with two sample plugins. Find in Finder searches inside the search results. The file associations are registered for the languages NotePadLX opens.

The interface language switches without a restart, and the menus and all dialogs are translated. Files that need admin rights are saved through pkexec. Right button + wheel switches documents, session files open as sessions, the first line can name a new tab, and HTML / XML files open in the encoding they declare.

Move / Open in New Instance (also by dragging a tab out of the window), Pin Tab, the tray icon, following the desktop's light / dark switch, theme tab colours, translated dialogs and a polished print dialog.

Printing (File > Print with the headers, footers and margins of Preferences > Print, and Print Now), Incremental Search, tab colours, Load / Save Session, Find characters in range, theme import and Edit Popup ContextMenu.

Settings > Preferences: the 23 pages of Notepad++, applied at once (tab bar, toolbar icons and colours, dark mode tones, editing, margins, languages, default directory and more). The Find dialog keeps one layout for all its tabs.
The editor keys work again: Duplicate Line (Ctrl+D), Cut / Delete Line, Select All, Copy, Cut, Paste, Undo and Redo.
The caret blinks at the start of a line: the editor's first pixel column of text is painted again.

A new About box, Debug Info and Check for Updates; full screen, Post-It and distraction free modes; Paste HTML/RTF and binary content, Open File and Redact Selection; every Notepad++ default key checked.
The Shortcut Mapper for menu commands, macros, Run commands and editor keys; the editor keys of shortcuts.xml are applied; function keys can be assigned to editor commands.
First public version: the main window, files and sessions, search, languages and styling, the docking panels, macros, the Run menu, the column editor and the hash tools.
